entities.name: Dreygar
entities.description: Wizard of the Western Domains who, in a Dominarian fable, took Aldon's Castle and ruled as a tyrant.

entities.name: Aldon
entities.description: Ruler who fought Dreygar and finally killed him.

entities.name: Serra Angel
entities.description: Angel Aldon was forced to ask to lead the fight; killed.

events.summary: Dreygar attacks Aldon with a Force of Nature, which is killed, and his goblin horde seizes the castle.
events.quote: Dreygar's horde of goblins seized the castle

events.summary: Aldon kills Dreygar after the Serra angel and fallen angel die.
events.quote: and Dreygar was killed by Aldon

relations.note: Slew him at the end of the fable
relations.quote: and Dreygar was killed by Aldon
